{{Top|leg}}
'''The Burning''' was a period of time on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byss (Abyssin)/Legends|Byss]] when it passed between the [[Byss and Abyss system|system's]] two [[Binary star/Legends|binary stars]]. During the Burning, Byss had no night, the weather patterns became erratic, and the temperature on the world became uncomfortably hot.
